description: rock_explode (bundle.deobfuscated.js:62622-62684) lives inside traits_config.onKO, already correctly dispatched by the existing _handle_faint wiring -- the bug is purely in the splash damage itself: the source recomputes a FRESH calcDamage (its own crit/variance RNG draws) PER alive enemy target (Geodude vs each of Squirtle/Charmander/Magikarp individually, using THAT target's own defense/held items), not one shared value applied to everyone. Squirtle's Water-type hit is guaranteed to KO Geodude (current_hp=1, and Water is super-effective against both of Geodude's types). Charmander and Magikarp have deliberately different defense stats so a correct per-target roll produces different splash damage on each, while the pre-fix Python (one calcDamage against the first alive enemy, applied flat to every enemy) does not. calcDamage is also called with battle_config=null in the source (bundle.deobfuscated.js:62649-62658), not the real battle_config -- covered separately by a Python unit test since no Dark-tier/weather trait is active here to make that difference observable in final state.
